# openwebui_openai_connections (Resource)

Manages the list of OpenAI-compatible API connections for Open WebUI. This is a singleton resource; the full list is replaced on every apply.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connections` (Attributes List) Ordered list of OpenAI-compatible connection entries. Order determines request priority. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Global toggle for all OpenAI-compatible connections (`ENABLE_OPENAI_API`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Required:

- `url` (String) Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. `https://api.openai.com/v1`.

Optional:

- `api_provider` (String) Provider hint. Set to `"azure"` to enable Azure OpenAI mode.
- `api_type` (String) API variant. Set to `"responses"` to use the Responses API; leave empty for Chat Completions.
- `api_version` (String) Azure API version string, e.g. `2024-02-01`. Required when `api_provider = "azure"`.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication method: `bearer` (default), `none`, `session`, `system_oauth`, `azure_ad`, or `microsoft_entra_id`.
- `connection_type` (String) Connection type label, e.g. `external`. Stored as-is; Open WebUI uses it for model tagging.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether this specific connection is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `headers_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object of custom HTTP headers sent to the endpoint, e.g. `jsonencode({ X-Org = "acme" })`.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) API key or bearer token. Sensitive. Set to `null` or omit to leave empty.
- `model_ids` (List of String) Allowlist of model IDs exposed from this connection. Empty list exposes all models.
- `prefix_id` (String) String prepended to every model ID from this connection, e.g. `openai`. Empty string disables prefixing.
- `tags` (List of String) Labels attached to models from this connection.
